body.text: Maryland's largest county rebuilt its 100-yard carry ban and was sued the same day it took effect — while New Jersey's rifle and magazine bans come down Friday with still no Attorney General guidance.

Montgomery County's Emergency Bill 23-26E was signed and took effect July 27; Maryland Shall Issue and five permit holders filed Barreto v. Montgomery County the same day, mapping 100-yard zones over more than 26% of the county. New Jersey is at T-2 with the AG's compliance guidance still unposted.
